title: A novel ZnO/Fe3+-doped Bi2WO6 photocatalyst with triple synergistic effect for solar-driven tetracycline degradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12689-12697
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01899D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hui Sun, Gaoyang Liang, Bingge Chen, Jingqi Jia, Hongxia Jing
In this study, a Z-scheme ZnO/Fe3+ -doped Bi2WO6 heterojunction was developed by Fe3+ doping and interface engineering. The synergistic effect of oxygen vacancies and optimized band structure achieved 95.5 % tetracycline degradation within 60 min.
